from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u065/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2e20a8a1.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        # Mark a single background cell immediately after a long horizontal run.
        color = max(set(row), key=row.count)
        n = len(row)
        k = 0
        while k < n and row[k] == color:
            k += 1
        if k > n // 2 and k < n and row[k] != color:
            out[r][k] = 1
    return out
''')
